# `operation-id-changed`

operationId changed

| | |
|---|---|
| **Kind** | `sdk` |
| **Default severity** | `info` · `--profile sdk`: `error` |
| **Rule IDs** | `operation-id-changed` |
| **Status** | Implemented (M3) |
| **Group** | Paths and operations ([RULES.md section 2](../../RULES.md)) |

## What it detects

The same method and path has a different `operationId` (or gained or lost one).

## Why this default

The JSON on the wire is unchanged, but generated SDKs name methods after the `operationId`, so code calling the old method name stops compiling.

## Example

From test case [`operation-id-changed`](../../test/cases/operation-id-changed/): A changed operationId is an sdk change: info under the wire profile.

`openapi.yaml`, base → revision:

```diff
  …
    '/pets':
      get:
-       operationId: listPets
+       operationId: getPets
        responses:
          '200':
```

Findings:

- `operation-id-changed` · info · GET /pets

## Policy options

Every rule takes `severity` (`error`, `warn`, `info` or `off`), `fix` and `explanation` in the policy file. The policy file arrives in M6; see [POLICY.md](../../POLICY.md).

```yaml
rules:
  operation-id-changed: info
```

## How to fix

Keep the old `operationId`. If the name must change, add the new operation alongside and deprecate the old one.
